record.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16456. Abstract summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable efficient scaling, but training them from scratch remains prohibitively expensive. MoE upcycling mitigates this cost by converting pretrained dense models into sparse MoE models. However, existing upcycling methods typically rely on large-scale continued training and often perform poorly un Out of scope: MoE upcycling initialization/training.
record.title: SPRI: SVD-Partitioned Residual Initialization for Data-Constrained MoE Upcycling
